notes: Corrected: be-ene is now one fused unit on unto with ayin as source head, replacing the accepted split that gave unto to the beth and left the construct noun unrepresented (rules 22, 30).
be-yadekha in the same verse is split, each of its morphemes holding an English word of its own; only the phrase whose construct noun is left with nothing fuses (rules 2, 30).
it seemeth good is read as the construction's copular frame on the predicate adjective; reading it seemeth as an added lexical verb under rule 20's boundary was the competing analysis.
